details: Following the US midterm elections on November 3, 2026, cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, rallied significantly as a Democratic sweep eased political uncertainty. Bitcoin reclaimed $80,000, and other major digital assets like Ethereum also saw substantial gains. This recovery was supported by a broader rally in US equities, declining oil prices, and easing Treasury yields, which improved overall risk appetite. Over $770 million in crypto short positions were liquidated, further fueling the upward movement.
title: US Midterm Election Results Boost Crypto Market and Risk Appetite

details: On November 4, 2026, US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded net inflows of $74.6 million, reversing a three-session withdrawal run totaling approximately $1.16 billion. Fidelity's FBTC led the positive flows with $236.7 million, while BlackRock's IBIT continued to experience outflows of $201.2 million. This return of net buying occurred even as Goldman Sachs and Bank of America pushed back their expected Federal Reserve rate cuts.
title: US Bitcoin ETFs See Resumed Inflows After Weeks of Outflows

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) is actively progressing its digital euro project, emphasizing public interest and modernizing Europe's monetary system through tokenized finance and improved cross-border payments. Executive Board member Piero Cipollone highlighted these efforts on November 5, 2026, as part of a broader strategy to maintain the euro's relevance in an increasingly digital economy. The ECB's initiatives also include experimenting with new features for the digital euro and exploring the Appia roadmap for a tokenized financial ecosystem.
title: ECB Prioritizes Public Interest in Digital Euro and Tokenized Finance

details: On October 29, 2026, Binance disclosed a major security incident resulting in the theft of approximately $6.3 billion in digital assets due to compromised internal systems. The exchange pledged to reimburse affected customers. This event triggered renewed scrutiny of exchange infrastructure, custody arrangements, and counterparty risk, contributing to weakened institutional ETF flows and overall market uncertainty in the crypto space.
title: Binance Faces Scrutiny After $6.3 Billion Security Breach
